 Kieran Culkin Wears Sami Zayn Shirt On ‘The Tonight Show’ 
 Skylar Russell November 19, 2026, 10:59 am 
 Facebook 
 X 
 Bluesky 
 Kieran Culkin represents the world champion.
 Wednesday’s episode of ‘The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon’ featured an appearance from Kieran Culkin, who stopped by to promote ‘The Hunger Games: Sunrise On The Reaping’.
 During a game of Catchphrase with Jimmy Fallon and Julia Garner , Culkin wore a Sami Zayn shirt . The shirt was also seen in backstage photos that he took.
 Kieran Culkin arrived to The Tonight Show in a Sami Zayn t-shirt
 ( @FallonTonight ) pic.twitter.com/MElClyl3uS 
 — WrestlePurists (@WrestlePurists) November 19, 2026 
 Zayn followed up the shoutout by sharing a great photo of the two of them swapping top prizes.
 Good things happen to good guys. https://t.co/pRBMhxv47A pic.twitter.com/mxJ3kZCHCI 
 — Sami Zayn (@SamiZayn) November 19, 2026 
 Sami Zayn won the WWE Championship from CM Punk on the September 11 episode of SmackDown. Since then, he’s defended the belt against names like Kevin Owens, Trick Williams, and Je’Von Evans.
 Kieran, Macaulay, and Rory are all noted wrestling fans. Fans can check out Fightful’s previous coverage of Macaulay Culkin by clicking here.
